page.name: 北斗
page.desc: 「南十字」船队头领，在璃月有着相当的声望。有人说她能开山劈海，有人说她善举剑引雷，还有人说，连可怖的冥海巨兽都不是北斗的一合之敌。外人也许会把这些话当做夸张的玩笑，但那些曾与北斗同航的人却会说——「世上若真有什么冥海巨兽，那北斗一定能将它劈作两截。」

但对「南十字」的船员们来说，最值得一谈的，还是北斗从凝光手里赢到了摩拉。

具体金额不详，比试次数也无从考证，但船员们都看见北斗醉醺醺地回到船上。瞧她那模样，绝对是已经痛饮了一场。

「下次得让那女人倾家荡产！」北斗说着，躺倒在甲板上。

如此豪言壮语…船员们就权当它是大姐头酒后的玩笑话了。

北斗是「南十字」的首领。

而「南十字」是以璃月港为根据地活动的武装船队。

所谓「武装船队」，只是字面上的意思：

一支装备了可靠火力的船队。

不必多想，「南十字」的一切作为均已得到七星的许可…大致如此。

北斗是一位能让全船队水手心服口服的首领。他们甚至愿意相信，北斗能够压制海上的巨浪与风暴。

「那可是北斗姐啊！再狂乱的风暴也得对更有威力的气象低头的嘛。」

{"list":[{"tab_name":"汉语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"我是北斗，听过我的「南十字」船队吗？如果你也喜欢冒险，那就跟着我吧。我罩你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d9d678fc6e3eedbf5195ea47095e7950_3566554713932688145.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·切磋","content":"想切磋的话，我随时奉陪。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/161dd99516e7167ea3b703b53632e82d_8399659800327231893.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·畅饮","content":"啊——干完活，喝口酒。真畅快。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7ba38c018aa637ef987096ad67f232fd_4902983036124608101.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·陆地","content":"难得在陆地上逗留那么久，居然有点不习惯了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/75495f8c3f2349357d15b8cb29846f3f_8086388038589855720.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"被困荒岛的时候，雨水就是宝贵的淡水来源。嗯…虽然现在是用不上啦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ef6d211438b7d4544cc8ca15a10f887c_2161962618571132432.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"喂，打雷而已。在海上不用怕，在陆地上，就更不用怕了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b5dfea7f7ced3c0b0a71ed7d1fbb8b44_775762334807698139.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"起风的时候…","content":"这天气，很适合出航啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ee1eec1a4c386cf4fde6727819c0e678_2888490303841312497.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"注意扬起来的风沙，别揉眼睛。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9188515d6dd0b2509d3567a49daf8c02_371847058410128444.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"哟，早。我准备出发了，一起来？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7e3d9563040dd288d77714e4e1e4c5d6_4235417998598561699.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"去香菱那吃午饭吧。你别说，这大锅热油炒出来的，还真和海上的烤鱼腌肉不一样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7a283d5a13028ebdd4faecb41f857602_8112935898360227172.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"好，出发喝酒去喽！嗯？哈哈哈，平时没人卖酒给你是吧？那不如——","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a4ec90ca37b09ad5ddf93c523ab15b8e_3578710267273730325.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"这时间过得可真快。去吧，一帆风顺。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/528e2c41b3a8a17913e7c569f22fe0b2_6937166199233181362.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于北斗自己…","content":"航海准备，兄弟们，各就各位，全新的冒险要开始了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ebe9bdab2d86f4d4638555557dc4c096_6165151421330337284.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·称呼","content":"我是老大，你是我兄弟，没问题吧？哈？这些叫法太老土？行。那就按你喜欢的方式叫吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3290739e406efb160b2f789244592387_4756417053922691341.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·识人","content":"我认人很准。当你见过大海，那么普通人脸上的小水花，可就太好读懂了。哈哈，所以，我第一眼就认准了你这个家伙。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e43096dd0479c0fd790a035a1353b033_6142642792766214872.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·选择","content":"你是我选择的船员，是我选择的兄弟。就说这一点，都够我自豪很久。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2f2f4761656a120045a2097e5b0cef43_2033739040508221867.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"在那些没有「神之眼」的家伙心中，拥有「神之眼」，获得了神的认可的人，应该是旗帜吧。那么，旗帜就该有旗帜的样子。我是这样鞭策自己的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/580b172ffbf2216124607607e779eff0_8875226996906338869.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"遇到难题了吗？不知道如何向前的话，总之先迈出第一步，后面的道路就会自然而然地展开了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/da8333e8f5a628b386a80e85ab79f159_5033022706642830672.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"每次远航回来看见石鸢的时候，就说明差不多快到家了。海上的景色看多了难免单调，相比之下，虽说是猛禽，但那副自在翱翔的模样，总觉得亲切可爱。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/810c5ab1a33038370fefe464039e9f5c_630515111650293848.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光·璃月七星","content":"凝光啊，从「璃月七星」的角度上来说已经做得很好了吧。只是，我要负责的对象从来就是我的船和兄弟们，不是什么「璃月七星」啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/68a5ca4ac1861ab168718d413445f57d_8718821800121586600.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光·态度","content":"凝光一向不怎么坦率，但她曾经很直接地表露过对我的不满。哈哈，不过啊，喜欢和讨厌都是她自己的事情，我是不可能动摇的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ded025bad218db104ab992f702f31b90_9115450253669866184.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱·好厨艺","content":"香菱的一手好菜，可是我们一众人在远航时的念想。没力气的时候，要是想想干煸绝云椒椒那满嘴留香的滋味，都能精神几分。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a36a5f89ef439cc353164a00d6439ddf_7829161754608133059.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱·试吃","content":"香菱啊，她偶尔也会用一些说不上好滋味的食材，做出一些很是了不得的味道。不过嘛，没有尝试就不会有进步，我倒是挺乐意帮她试吃的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/90acf3e80ec4a628bba905c25582c35b_4523433407867463025.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"你说「往生堂」的那位先生吗？兄弟们有时会聊起他的传言，听上去是个很有意思的人啊。嗯，有机会去结交一下吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6185c05119644b6ce2838549be65dfee_1426191912816382769.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于魈…","content":"有一年海灯节前夕，船队在归航时遭遇了风暴，紧赶慢赶才在入夜时分回到了璃月港。那时候海灯早就散了。我却在孤云阁的方向，看到了空中悬着一个少年模样的仙人。想必就如传闻一样，在人们看不见的地方，也有人在守护这个璃月港吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ded068b692c5606798a3ea54757ac800_8676131026135617034.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于甘雨…","content":"我和甘雨那丫头私交不错！但你也知道，她是「璃月七星」的秘书，「七星」不待见我那可不是一天两天了。哈，我倒是无所谓，要连累了那丫头可不行。嗯，对外还是保密得好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dc84cdefc6c8c37aba89941fc515f9c0_8350801275925941424.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"哈，很有意思的丫头！船上的兄弟们也有喜欢听她「摇滚」的。嗯…我本人？怎么说呢，虽然在某些方面跟辛焱有共同话题，但我的音乐品味却是另一方面的…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e6b2df31b6fc6bf17e2ffe816ad08126_8043765738243998794.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于瑶瑶…","content":"瑶瑶这个小家伙啊，总是爱到船上来玩。但她那副扑闪着眼睛，见什么都新奇的样子，让谁都狠不下心来赶她走。唉，差点要打乱出航的计划。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9c2a04c75aa522aaa3ab743c8d4d03c3_1772963858672037706.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于枫原万叶…","content":"听说万叶那小子在天守阁外挡了雷电将军的一刀，不简单嘛！嗯…战争结束后，他回了我们南十字船队，说是继续和我们同行一段时间。我当然是非常欢迎了，如果哪天他决定要独自踏上下一段旅程，我再打一壶好酒为他送行，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/79d77f73e45b4065a77b02d6e9fc354f_380542631044963193.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其一","content":"想要踏上我的「死兆星」号，得先回答我一个问题。大海之中充满凶险，告诉我——你为什么想上我的船？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d7db8b1272c7a06b13550d3764607765_7699174321617114425.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其二","content":"那些关于我的传奇故事？哈哈哈，那是兄弟们看重，才在夸我的时候添油加醋。不过，你要问我怕不怕在出海的时候遇到什么魔物，那自然是不怕的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2020a0d4598b1df244d95d6cfb42d49d_1055665819449588090.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其三","content":"问我帮助平民的用意？哈，哪有什么用意不用意的。谁的人生还没有个低谷。我的帮助是小事，但对他们而言，迈不迈得过去那道坎，可能就是两条路啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c92dddd7e03bac272ccf424e7f75a6c1_7373280930851590577.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其四","content":"我经历过痛苦的时光。小时候没摩拉买吃的，只好偷人家树上的果子，讨了几年生活。等到有了自己的船队，还是被趾高气昂的商人们排挤在外。但是，这些事当作茶余饭后的笑谈讲给你听，就足够了，我绝不会让你再经历一遍。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/83a2783bd7aaa040c1013c2787af3984_8785326902795022035.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其五","content":"追随我的兄弟有很多，我问过，我也记得他们每一个人上船的理由。你是很特别的。我知道你还有需要完成的事情，我不会授予你职务和头衔。但无论你的旅途去往何方，「死兆星」号上，永远都有你的位置。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4d253cfb440a3c1b1e7c097f17a71433_4021849352875712107.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"北斗的爱好…","content":"爱好啊…我想想。冒险算一个，掌舵算一个，交朋友算一个，喝酒算一个，吃好吃的算一个…啧，一个手都数不过来啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a4fd413e479647cf7fb68957cbd73579_6433879731130126320.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"北斗的烦恼…","content":"搞得定的事不必烦恼，搞不定的事烦恼也没有意义。我就这样过得快快活活的。哦，要是你遇到什么想不通的事情，你可以来找我。我帮你一起解决。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/846aaf2108512c958201e4849bab3f14_152981750088810277.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"我喜欢味道重的菜！什么炝炒肉片啊，麻婆豆腐啊我就很喜欢。能填饱肚子，大家围坐一圈一起吃的时候，气氛也会变得火热火热的。哈，说得我都想去吃一顿了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4c69a6d6a2536c48be2edea485285056_5541372306861523907.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"我不太喜欢吃凉菜冷盘。有这慢悠悠开胃的功夫，鱼都能烤熟几条了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/89241f3b31bfcc4f1af47531436ab97c_1059610761517203456.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"好味道，我喜欢！有米饭吗，帮忙添两碗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/0ac768d8ea4379a1500688fdc187e396_1900940718446174112.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"你的手艺真不错，让人心情也变得不一样了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/703d5be091354224fa9e1890f38e0d3f_5841974405952003286.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"菜是好菜，这就够了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/839be594f9b8917bcf437bc52d1a15ed_2434233496143381806.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"来，上船。我早就跟兄弟们约好把时间腾出来了，吃的喝的也都准备好了。今天你生日，让你做一天老大。哈！嗯，想去哪？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/10814eab6784f526946cf02cfe1705c3_1569820960216307531.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"痛快！又变强了不少。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/066a481fef4401247f222bf72277dc31_7260588954679085585.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"这满载而归的滋味，开瓶美酒来庆祝吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/75bca946433be4289c5243aa775dd724_9159865431476794660.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"好样的，有你这种得力的兄弟，是我北斗的荣光！我也不能让你小瞧了啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e0340d582f346eab5b4addb736bafac7_7751529839790757796.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"这几番操练下来，算是达到了我武艺的巅峰状态了吧。谢谢你…对了，不如再陪我过两招吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/162770e6262ebb2b1ff700b48781e141_2965430968500554974.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"闪开！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/64bc511117c20fb021495fbba9f4e6c4_1657220836421733887.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"哈！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f639f58e880fb9609103efab9fb30371_1402495767293925028.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"悉数奉还！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/124a78576f165a58119618c85c8697e3_9216947413974629777.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"接下吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ca298bd3bb15bd9e3a05d49d12721dd1_1327637793569503026.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其五","content":"——喝啊！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/60c98023b06cfe301dc53a69a5c24019_5400252668028093533.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"这是斩灭「海山」的力量！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6aa2490132b2a43ac437fdeb19683ed8_8128177849731686456.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"给我瞧好了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6e92faf7c04f90fa36b5900b89725e3c_6388933708883576301.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"化作焦炭吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/af4f65f383307f3f5c3d2b943038e272_601172833017361946.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"哟，真让人开心。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/36f89fa609a733e22ef08114d55d7b4b_5850591436186610937.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"不错嘛，又有收获了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/705ac05b72e5a7df9ce3693d1f05140b_5319746650092107854.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"找到了财宝，就来喝酒助兴吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2059db3e44f0efe156dbe7ba294542bc_1970813584405846153.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"还没完呢！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b7f5f948883682fc15bd1bfc0323b8b0_8259708928368152280.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"哼，我来精神了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/41b9917380efc9d70757074e0c8a194e_2718928605739928442.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"我绝不屈服。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a67a391db8b43ddcfbe7e82efb0de9e6_4133548140597641031.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"到我身后！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/7c1c7776e593168395a62eb3acb0c94a_3662441555021129779.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"退下！别逞英雄。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/d2e5360154bdd8ea5965b443e75b8e37_36264136536944092.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"糟透了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d75659c8510f018cd00d3a973ea1da3d_7836654611391655780.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"兄弟们…先…撤…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1e31f26928a6ae7d21cf9abd03522486_3170047578588224076.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"全员…归航…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7c61fb58a7e9b5269406f7096aa2fe95_235140108819545762.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"普通受击·其一","content":"区区小伤。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/062864a5b073bc94ebfc5370d30e7a77_1525209696793392494.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"输赢还说不定呢。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ee4d432f7d513d572f6d29069c9c0b75_4273744315679106069.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其二","content":"有两下子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fa10cbe40fd85a78da2509d932a3c37e_653391248118535019.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"好，出发吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/eae8568b7a5632f520b0e3a05c9f904e_118800411243782216.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"跟我来吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5c94e64bda6aee3ef144bfb06b5065ce_3142137696924743686.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"我相信你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/023404871ece8a9e1f4142767284fe3a_5024992466249043597.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1703216308653_0"},{"tab_name":"日语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"我是北斗，听过我的「南十字」船队吗？如果你也喜欢冒险，那就跟着我吧。我罩你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9d886eacc1033badc4a08261331e5cd7_1021220470297891291.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·切磋","content":"想切磋的话，我随时奉陪。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a53328c287416b0ece4dd55f5d6bc04a_3660816272124046449.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·畅饮","content":"啊——干完活，喝口酒。真畅快。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ec8cb7a027e9f74279da4dc977172524_7531367740929123835.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·陆地","content":"难得在陆地上逗留那么久，居然有点不习惯了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/10a561f126831ec695c73ede8a2f5fac_6870997007888249833.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"被困荒岛的时候，雨水就是宝贵的淡水来源。嗯…虽然现在是用不上啦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7ff68bf4e694aff00f7b99eded8b71ce_7111081988461481238.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"喂，打雷而已。在海上不用怕，在陆地上，就更不用怕了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/84f6a4f35e43fcb434bb1aef05227423_5083019213287743573.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"起风的时候…","content":"这天气，很适合出航啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1002921d21458bd67f2dba4912c47153_5604542589730941434.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"注意扬起来的风沙，别揉眼睛。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/18e1eb71d8db13179683713427d940de_2535646826907070413.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"哟，早。我准备出发了，一起来？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/253d5694b0f10520d390446eb8f467c6_4252538217034348034.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"去香菱那吃午饭吧。你别说，这大锅热油炒出来的，还真和海上的烤鱼腌肉不一样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/29e0fa1ee57c4af348d7b926699fd5ef_9086145438335523699.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"好，出发喝酒去喽！嗯？哈哈哈，平时没人卖酒给你是吧？那不如——","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7f22bccae898fb37608efb8df3a75328_1406887351212942434.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"这时间过得可真快。去吧，一帆风顺。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1ea88f677c57d7e8b5f9aa382a05095f_8758944052534961049.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于北斗自己…","content":"航海准备，兄弟们，各就各位，全新的冒险要开始了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/99367b1c133e31bae7f65e2ff9e1b463_4001647770052173788.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·称呼","content":"我是老大，你是我兄弟，没问题吧？哈？这些叫法太老土？行。那就按你喜欢的方式叫吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fa2a9569064fc186bdfa1d8d09820a97_1548581865455158337.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·识人","content":"我认人很准。当你见过大海，那么普通人脸上的小水花，可就太好读懂了。哈哈，所以，我第一眼就认准了你这个家伙。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e19c719aa864f1dc6275d7cf13e95a5b_7922754892092133517.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·选择","content":"你是我选择的船员，是我选择的兄弟。就说这一点，都够我自豪很久。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/07018215890b3c814d57466f104b2861_6886665475468815513.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"在那些没有「神之眼」的家伙心中，拥有「神之眼」，获得了神的认可的人，应该是旗帜吧。那么，旗帜就该有旗帜的样子。我是这样鞭策自己的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5ee832bd4b40fd67ef5a8ec2ab9dfdb1_7899966038986083703.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"遇到难题了吗？不知道如何向前的话，总之先迈出第一步，后面的道路就会自然而然地展开了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/60acebf4e241ab9cfbbffa652e0e2572_5967245791866342487.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"每次远航回来看见石鸢的时候，就说明差不多快到家了。海上的景色看多了难免单调，相比之下，虽说是猛禽，但那副自在翱翔的模样，总觉得亲切可爱。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2bd579cbe27c4cfe01da918b40c820d2_8485930282093697602.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光·璃月七星","content":"凝光啊，从「璃月七星」的角度上来说已经做得很好了吧。只是，我要负责的对象从来就是我的船和兄弟们，不是什么「璃月七星」啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/64079783ae8113cc8a62b7d40cf56b4e_3486028765769201762.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光·态度","content":"凝光一向不怎么坦率，但她曾经很直接地表露过对我的不满。哈哈，不过啊，喜欢和讨厌都是她自己的事情，我是不可能动摇的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f1f02d4b407bed18f7de8db4ea8d99d0_7157154158136134360.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱·好厨艺","content":"香菱的一手好菜，可是我们一众人在远航时的念想。没力气的时候，要是想想干煸绝云椒椒那满嘴留香的滋味，都能精神几分。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d70bb70120003d4cbe2090981175e6fc_64460791534703001.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱·试吃","content":"香菱啊，她偶尔也会用一些说不上好滋味的食材，做出一些很是了不得的味道。不过嘛，没有尝试就不会有进步，我倒是挺乐意帮她试吃的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c867f370b4ae1f773124fa7ba5d9c943_4267002416287657698.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"你说「往生堂」的那位先生吗？兄弟们有时会聊起他的传言，听上去是个很有意思的人啊。嗯，有机会去结交一下吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/37e4a016b32370177f7bac95d835c967_5778854763172967267.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于魈…","content":"有一年海灯节前夕，船队在归航时遭遇了风暴，紧赶慢赶才在入夜时分回到了璃月港。那时候海灯早就散了。我却在孤云阁的方向，看到了空中悬着一个少年模样的仙人。想必就如传闻一样，在人们看不见的地方，也有人在守护这个璃月港吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cdc3a1a50678566d39124d6066e8c2a7_8125722992125767187.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于甘雨…","content":"我和甘雨那丫头私交不错！但你也知道，她是「璃月七星」的秘书，「七星」不待见我那可不是一天两天了。哈，我倒是无所谓，要连累了那丫头可不行。嗯，对外还是保密得好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9b4ffffb6b248efb3278ba14e148ca27_9011330029157818517.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"哈，很有意思的丫头！船上的兄弟们也有喜欢听她「摇滚」的。嗯…我本人？怎么说呢，虽然在某些方面跟辛焱有共同话题，但我的音乐品味却是另一方面的…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2ecafe69645302d742e392458cc2d558_1321029635641738399.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于瑶瑶…","content":"瑶瑶这个小家伙啊，总是爱到船上来玩。但她那副扑闪着眼睛，见什么都新奇的样子，让谁都狠不下心来赶她走。唉，差点要打乱出航的计划。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a462dbb533758cec1a879a8aa4e903d1_764961834618236081.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于枫原万叶…","content":"听说万叶那小子在天守阁外挡了雷电将军的一刀，不简单嘛！嗯…战争结束后，他回了我们南十字船队，说是继续和我们同行一段时间。我当然是非常欢迎了，如果哪天他决定要独自踏上下一段旅程，我再打一壶好酒为他送行，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3035409643e8f2addcb435f89afcd3e0_2652753508202757642.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其一","content":"想要踏上我的「死兆星」号，得先回答我一个问题。大海之中充满凶险，告诉我——你为什么想上我的船？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f128d88b83cf71490a7bff02cb7d8942_3940509017943536545.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其二","content":"那些关于我的传奇故事？哈哈哈，那是兄弟们看重，才在夸我的时候添油加醋。不过，你要问我怕不怕在出海的时候遇到什么魔物，那自然是不怕的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cf46ecb60b7ccc19799f9dff961f0850_8645195003188908823.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其三","content":"问我帮助平民的用意？哈，哪有什么用意不用意的。谁的人生还没有个低谷。我的帮助是小事，但对他们而言，迈不迈得过去那道坎，可能就是两条路啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7ba0a2b6f03b1ba1efda9b4435d20ab8_2649828250058933947.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其四","content":"我经历过痛苦的时光。小时候没摩拉买吃的，只好偷人家树上的果子，讨了几年生活。等到有了自己的船队，还是被趾高气昂的商人们排挤在外。但是，这些事当作茶余饭后的笑谈讲给你听，就足够了，我绝不会让你再经历一遍。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/84e61dcb7203517b00dc0226bad6b8b7_5540405469191629945.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其五","content":"追随我的兄弟有很多，我问过，我也记得他们每一个人上船的理由。你是很特别的。我知道你还有需要完成的事情，我不会授予你职务和头衔。但无论你的旅途去往何方，「死兆星」号上，永远都有你的位置。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d9a89115e3d8b7ce9679c4989a27e9ec_5210426904258295723.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"北斗的爱好…","content":"爱好啊…我想想。冒险算一个，掌舵算一个，交朋友算一个，喝酒算一个，吃好吃的算一个…啧，一个手都数不过来啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ef6e593495882aef0ab262e2e7ef2738_9158104175607314468.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"北斗的烦恼…","content":"搞得定的事不必烦恼，搞不定的事烦恼也没有意义。我就这样过得快快活活的。哦，要是你遇到什么想不通的事情，你可以来找我。我帮你一起解决。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7bff08bb9eddbdd48b5a1c1237e49367_453510354472927704.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"我喜欢味道重的菜！什么炝炒肉片啊，麻婆豆腐啊我就很喜欢。能填饱肚子，大家围坐一圈一起吃的时候，气氛也会变得火热火热的。哈，说得我都想去吃一顿了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/21c30ec6fd34db3903c95972b86bb50a_7855323554248445140.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"我不太喜欢吃凉菜冷盘。有这慢悠悠开胃的功夫，鱼都能烤熟几条了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9ab5b1fdd4e2db93e2fd1e5c4857380c_4283881240721840803.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"好味道，我喜欢！有米饭吗，帮忙添两碗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/c8d7263950f856948febf7ccf311a096_8203557091030087770.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"你的手艺真不错，让人心情也变得不一样了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/ef3c2cc2a3a97d310d711ae39c03c61b_711354561210994508.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"菜是好菜，这就够了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/66595938f2f5686feac01930b9032bab_1212055622814306925.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"来，上船。我早就跟兄弟们约好把时间腾出来了，吃的喝的也都准备好了。今天你生日，让你做一天老大。哈！嗯，想去哪？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/af05eb297549e05f482a8f705aed07f1_6881405739752308518.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"痛快！又变强了不少。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e8eae597e628d15e953cc28b805e25fd_8139174589866955682.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"这满载而归的滋味，开瓶美酒来庆祝吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8b0e34e0d4ebc3a61f0e7bee04559cdd_314339732872274470.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"好样的，有你这种得力的兄弟，是我北斗的荣光！我也不能让你小瞧了啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/104486c2db2d3d841fe839817cb39743_3788729269629687611.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"这几番操练下来，算是达到了我武艺的巅峰状态了吧。谢谢你…对了，不如再陪我过两招吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d162ef8d25599c0c93106cd97055ebb3_4608311273193447543.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"闪开！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f3e88038b62af19e40a9b118e06ad886_1908108907553143.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"哈！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bb6216cc9a8fb1b89e75bdbed773b7cf_5895778255990107997.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"悉数奉还！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/80ba525f93e159cc7fe0fa3a2786764d_6903326924433909657.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"接下吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1a7dcf18914782e59d051c049f47d4a5_6693803628764886514.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其五","content":"——喝啊！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/21dd3094aeeb434292d6b154fa081f0a_4847591838508288210.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"这是斩灭「海山」的力量！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8e1b1eb7c4e75db88eca846353a3d03f_3987334288494029668.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"给我瞧好了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/dc7634a3cad2c8e3a1d6def28d30b3bf_5277660774686190289.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"化作焦炭吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/02da5f2c63606df9c58054674d10b8dc_256103235786775771.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"哟，真让人开心。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d6df58dae733a3dc70eca432bad43985_6773561212574763407.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"不错嘛，又有收获了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/684da2a05343af52dd2abe1a25e22195_6955168636777525033.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"找到了财宝，就来喝酒助兴吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/549643009e4298770256eb64240c6752_1055409564493513294.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"还没完呢！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8430d8af5a26aa9472e17791e5b83249_7269229379855021361.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"哼，我来精神了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f0485c5bf145ea02231847bf3402b4e8_50228249939802521.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"我绝不屈服。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a4e5676203ecc8514cf756eb4dd0e60b_6832612109582452191.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"到我身后！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/b733afb5f45fc44baafe59c2b6351d5a_6830251230027648191.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"退下！别逞英雄。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/765fb2838eff7cd4b8e9f33ab942d6b9_4617004593533188554.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"糟透了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a6e910e1052b19da8878d58b972004e8_8033628759439562751.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"兄弟们…先…撤…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a01af5540f60d9c3eecc1b04dbdeca93_261049948796138345.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"全员…归航…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7fbc3d88d3aa9a501ec3de7258775c26_7069118952342485194.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"普通受击·其一","content":"区区小伤。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a6da71341b9d3032b98c5248e43ce869_2666827566798929291.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"输赢还说不定呢。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/17c9bad0638f66cfa55ea7e369ce8585_5838259154062032613.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其二","content":"有两下子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/77c60b5e50846431258fc11d14ad7eec_457759644201947604.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"好，出发吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c9fd31119129f9396f776281dc349d05_465089432596848210.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"跟我来吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/05bcc0b79a0a9560ba4c73382ed95fdf_3999464675793535550.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"我相信你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1aa6c94dbdc439b329ada73ce1c6c368_8687404985632141932.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1703216308653_1"},{"tab_name":"韩语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"我是北斗，听过我的「南十字」船队吗？如果你也喜欢冒险，那就跟着我吧。我罩你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f02334601ba5a4c7b25a859ae1750d18_6140289252641402969.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·切磋","content":"想切磋的话，我随时奉陪。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4cb33666e727089c175486722d817212_8580693936093269643.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·畅饮","content":"啊——干完活，喝口酒。真畅快。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/483e2ae60c16be58ccaaab49acb5be71_1836730926704136234.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·陆地","content":"难得在陆地上逗留那么久，居然有点不习惯了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a39017a08b3036bdbd14e94f2b561e58_5009702056377640131.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"被困荒岛的时候，雨水就是宝贵的淡水来源。嗯…虽然现在是用不上啦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/26e32f735b1e2f02bbd3e04e38609083_7584895274775847090.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"喂，打雷而已。在海上不用怕，在陆地上，就更不用怕了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c983a220fccc11d1784b0efa657318a9_3199236755714814193.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"起风的时候…","content":"这天气，很适合出航啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/df71030018ac0925a516b3684ce8825d_1493984260416804080.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"注意扬起来的风沙，别揉眼睛。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3e62c4993ff5b1a8a564dad4b0f72393_4819664482279773426.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"哟，早。我准备出发了，一起来？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a3a79d91bfa603616d3564cbbe68a887_8300612966990069543.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"去香菱那吃午饭吧。你别说，这大锅热油炒出来的，还真和海上的烤鱼腌肉不一样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/86fe578176cf94ea3f53349cee6f0179_6550086189319045756.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"好，出发喝酒去喽！嗯？哈哈哈，平时没人卖酒给你是吧？那不如——","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/12c0449902ea1bf1a562a56fb50ea7c4_8884672035442872320.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"这时间过得可真快。去吧，一帆风顺。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4dc1796eec7c23a3ccd2ef3f9231c777_5320528974295839870.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于北斗自己…","content":"航海准备，兄弟们，各就各位，全新的冒险要开始了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/541367c36257ddf0bd04ca4760d2b703_9004458110931081005.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·称呼","content":"我是老大，你是我兄弟，没问题吧？哈？这些叫法太老土？行。那就按你喜欢的方式叫吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0c2b885bb108f22c9dc58c468623d347_1758191051095631289.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·识人","content":"我认人很准。当你见过大海，那么普通人脸上的小水花，可就太好读懂了。哈哈，所以，我第一眼就认准了你这个家伙。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/599954b7ce945dcc38a0979b7c4bdca0_8061313826628825630.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·选择","content":"你是我选择的船员，是我选择的兄弟。就说这一点，都够我自豪很久。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5509fe91c716e17f533deb35c98bee10_2599510413903780615.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"在那些没有「神之眼」的家伙心中，拥有「神之眼」，获得了神的认可的人，应该是旗帜吧。那么，旗帜就该有旗帜的样子。我是这样鞭策自己的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8863434c5c77cf631beccf7d79292006_3867148529951883243.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"遇到难题了吗？不知道如何向前的话，总之先迈出第一步，后面的道路就会自然而然地展开了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4b9114511524b0d203bdfab4957b1ff6_7837218131384482626.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"每次远航回来看见石鸢的时候，就说明差不多快到家了。海上的景色看多了难免单调，相比之下，虽说是猛禽，但那副自在翱翔的模样，总觉得亲切可爱。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e1a9643b66b9b80e8cfbebb6334687ae_6168195452159056970.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光·璃月七星","content":"凝光啊，从「璃月七星」的角度上来说已经做得很好了吧。只是，我要负责的对象从来就是我的船和兄弟们，不是什么「璃月七星」啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/82517d418513dfe4472d976d941aaafb_4512642911661466326.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光·态度","content":"凝光一向不怎么坦率，但她曾经很直接地表露过对我的不满。哈哈，不过啊，喜欢和讨厌都是她自己的事情，我是不可能动摇的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/913c04658e7448db5ed2d2d8ca51d0ad_4163294709920148496.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱·好厨艺","content":"香菱的一手好菜，可是我们一众人在远航时的念想。没力气的时候，要是想想干煸绝云椒椒那满嘴留香的滋味，都能精神几分。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fd4b8b89de67aefb69aa6b8e397e932d_6554130100166895585.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱·试吃","content":"香菱啊，她偶尔也会用一些说不上好滋味的食材，做出一些很是了不得的味道。不过嘛，没有尝试就不会有进步，我倒是挺乐意帮她试吃的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9f72ebdafe4417df262fef8366bff46e_1322868663916372637.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"你说「往生堂」的那位先生吗？兄弟们有时会聊起他的传言，听上去是个很有意思的人啊。嗯，有机会去结交一下吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e2fc2c9e78f9df3cee0c6f2ae0ef4910_8412845541431093052.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于魈…","content":"有一年海灯节前夕，船队在归航时遭遇了风暴，紧赶慢赶才在入夜时分回到了璃月港。那时候海灯早就散了。我却在孤云阁的方向，看到了空中悬着一个少年模样的仙人。想必就如传闻一样，在人们看不见的地方，也有人在守护这个璃月港吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7b6a156755fa7cb883b8ae2d4bf1eb15_5451955767779072401.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于甘雨…","content":"我和甘雨那丫头私交不错！但你也知道，她是「璃月七星」的秘书，「七星」不待见我那可不是一天两天了。哈，我倒是无所谓，要连累了那丫头可不行。嗯，对外还是保密得好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/870b40c9ad26c1fd653c6c87760ead6a_487145864505658048.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"哈，很有意思的丫头！船上的兄弟们也有喜欢听她「摇滚」的。嗯…我本人？怎么说呢，虽然在某些方面跟辛焱有共同话题，但我的音乐品味却是另一方面的…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b1fbe268b4768a0ecc5b6da895a73031_3272025574322981678.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于瑶瑶…","content":"瑶瑶这个小家伙啊，总是爱到船上来玩。但她那副扑闪着眼睛，见什么都新奇的样子，让谁都狠不下心来赶她走。唉，差点要打乱出航的计划。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/357f6dce97f7df7612a99fc88ecea4ef_6409646358335162405.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于枫原万叶…","content":"听说万叶那小子在天守阁外挡了雷电将军的一刀，不简单嘛！嗯…战争结束后，他回了我们南十字船队，说是继续和我们同行一段时间。我当然是非常欢迎了，如果哪天他决定要独自踏上下一段旅程，我再打一壶好酒为他送行，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/365abfec981c187239c752867e27a1fd_1651057605989602512.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其一","content":"想要踏上我的「死兆星」号，得先回答我一个问题。大海之中充满凶险，告诉我——你为什么想上我的船？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d339575561f14be76297a23c13122502_6900377172432935688.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其二","content":"那些关于我的传奇故事？哈哈哈，那是兄弟们看重，才在夸我的时候添油加醋。不过，你要问我怕不怕在出海的时候遇到什么魔物，那自然是不怕的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/56344cfacf6d893a78d02c6833709576_2829808332104156902.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其三","content":"问我帮助平民的用意？哈，哪有什么用意不用意的。谁的人生还没有个低谷。我的帮助是小事，但对他们而言，迈不迈得过去那道坎，可能就是两条路啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5d3f072a05c195bb6bcaef527fbd9f8b_6856735122846850949.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其四","content":"我经历过痛苦的时光。小时候没摩拉买吃的，只好偷人家树上的果子，讨了几年生活。等到有了自己的船队，还是被趾高气昂的商人们排挤在外。但是，这些事当作茶余饭后的笑谈讲给你听，就足够了，我绝不会让你再经历一遍。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/862b221d2ac5ba1d166d9edcf3370771_1685396450753387978.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其五","content":"追随我的兄弟有很多，我问过，我也记得他们每一个人上船的理由。你是很特别的。我知道你还有需要完成的事情，我不会授予你职务和头衔。但无论你的旅途去往何方，「死兆星」号上，永远都有你的位置。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/62b0a729f8a48665f84a051fe72bad55_6209713487169967248.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"北斗的爱好…","content":"爱好啊…我想想。冒险算一个，掌舵算一个，交朋友算一个，喝酒算一个，吃好吃的算一个…啧，一个手都数不过来啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6d59908b95ceaf608c76531f12d8bbd9_7140919990061499143.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"北斗的烦恼…","content":"搞得定的事不必烦恼，搞不定的事烦恼也没有意义。我就这样过得快快活活的。哦，要是你遇到什么想不通的事情，你可以来找我。我帮你一起解决。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/a82947d94ebd9908ed9ba05bc24e5964_111135327713173205.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"我喜欢味道重的菜！什么炝炒肉片啊，麻婆豆腐啊我就很喜欢。能填饱肚子，大家围坐一圈一起吃的时候，气氛也会变得火热火热的。哈，说得我都想去吃一顿了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/31fa9dd4bfb3d9c21768aee6caafa089_4769135611855663405.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"我不太喜欢吃凉菜冷盘。有这慢悠悠开胃的功夫，鱼都能烤熟几条了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/257ba09d9c7f9b4ae0ab0b99aa1c6b69_5786589969893267249.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"好味道，我喜欢！有米饭吗，帮忙添两碗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/473200639766e65dd7502aff0259beb9_414101924762851595.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"你的手艺真不错，让人心情也变得不一样了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/3c9a84023670b55f83cf87c6e08393ea_1315416397747291408.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"菜是好菜，这就够了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/950d8e5ac7b6d10463ff8716e6d4ca8b_5844484966750449448.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"来，上船。我早就跟兄弟们约好把时间腾出来了，吃的喝的也都准备好了。今天你生日，让你做一天老大。哈！嗯，想去哪？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7b9d284eb37756ae49d38a4796828138_8235204607474653466.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"痛快！又变强了不少。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ff1faecfc92aa8ca545280168957af83_292377942071403803.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"这满载而归的滋味，开瓶美酒来庆祝吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4c6a1e14a944d185e9af01a4f616c0aa_1560184382477980646.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"好样的，有你这种得力的兄弟，是我北斗的荣光！我也不能让你小瞧了啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e140ffeac8505f645844ff78c41ab3d3_5307503338263516991.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"这几番操练下来，算是达到了我武艺的巅峰状态了吧。谢谢你…对了，不如再陪我过两招吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/46155652bad2268bf17f70d280924540_2634024470192040955.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"闪开！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c158d555281e76c8c29d5c4ce4a8e73f_8975483277238475101.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"哈！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/31bbb814cf9aefdfe59394490abc47ad_484164861811547413.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"悉数奉还！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0668ef2bac5f5c0cb97be35852c393d7_8995420647919058458.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"接下吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c94271df113c7b59868e9f1780325e32_2866588707441330341.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素战技·其五","content":"——喝啊！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ea1497cdae24b709055a0975e66f925d_8227494384569548804.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"这是斩灭「海山」的力量！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e676d2828a60459867b320a5e9166306_4734323391207661956.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"给我瞧好了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e9bbce2fef27df30f3d53fb7ac8e86b8_4329153487277301361.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"化作焦炭吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/076329af27a411e0262e99209880bc35_4876439964488877023.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"哟，真让人开心。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/e5fd51f75c93b7d185173077f55e9e09_3028236496287505885.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"不错嘛，又有收获了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/0d8675ff4741b949521bb2ea92d192ba_5604062072933423120.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"找到了财宝，就来喝酒助兴吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1bc9fbe228ce9013bad5eca9dd045a2e_8978483982273270914.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"还没完呢！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bc5c5f0a69cb75aa2528fe89bc12003f_5101531189493107526.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"哼，我来精神了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/cc3f2d1a6a6056a85a376410626f5acd_4544094682203305652.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"我绝不屈服。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3b7b8ac96b73362cc3ad63e692202ad1_4620163610384679266.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其一","content":"到我身后！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/2364aa7c110e5d69806f25f0f99fc4e9_4803054458458297932.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"同伴生命值低·其二","content":"退下！别逞英雄。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/263ff8d700b1a814e7bd7cd9251644dd_5621463383741231787.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其一","content":"糟透了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/75e2491fa778188ab4e11ab995994822_8240468791307566690.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其二","content":"兄弟们…先…撤…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ebacb9879cb13f530056f049dd83b947_2599249114166484658.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"倒下·其三","content":"全员…归航…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fe1e3f776a61c453f31e5e5a5719ff29_1894595750100242884.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"普通受击·其一","content":"区区小伤。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4bdcb9a389b6c658a15ca366e356c675_3783130404617208145.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其一","content":"输赢还说不定呢。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/10a2b9dade089aff79507c5e51514d8e_598089242276143393.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"重受击·其二","content":"有两下子。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8f758cfa5acd576aa4554306f31dc26e_6607526490382370964.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其一","content":"好，出发吧！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8c1cadf66b9a5ec8c9271846e1dc4ea0_231281850942049771.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其二","content":"跟我来吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f1f238437427f9d468232edc289592ef_7110521167267447683.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"加入队伍·其三","content":"我相信你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/6962dc34fdccfac9902188c799e7a1af_5973363848322516433.mp3","audio_name":""}],"tab_id":"1703216308653_2"},{"tab_name":"英语","table":[{"name":"初次见面…","content":"我是北斗，听过我的「南十字」船队吗？如果你也喜欢冒险，那就跟着我吧。我罩你。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4c70193d6c4681e11f651da011211c25_6322802043418320004.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·切磋","content":"想切磋的话，我随时奉陪。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5c0090e73e3246e88f2463aa2e2da4da_3040018946483233726.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·畅饮","content":"啊——干完活，喝口酒。真畅快。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/98276322bcffa180c5fe5643ed619a34_8861664848316124246.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"闲聊·陆地","content":"难得在陆地上逗留那么久，居然有点不习惯了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/1a498a74b88867a04101e9a0cd83a59b_2839512457887871244.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"被困荒岛的时候，雨水就是宝贵的淡水来源。嗯…虽然现在是用不上啦。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9b29fb7e1c710a82f173ab7cc953cb27_7743515689140839326.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"喂，打雷而已。在海上不用怕，在陆地上，就更不用怕了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/01a8185c1cc662021b5748e232adb4bd_1264608973725080771.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"起风的时候…","content":"这天气，很适合出航啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4e1653db109b2bcd216b484eaeafe5da_1704532207058405152.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"注意扬起来的风沙，别揉眼睛。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/76b67b588dc87c7698598b8fefcdd31a_7700294340443906869.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"早上好…","content":"哟，早。我准备出发了，一起来？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/d96a02d072b974a3b46fd451e715cf06_4806414119517688013.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"中午好…","content":"去香菱那吃午饭吧。你别说，这大锅热油炒出来的，还真和海上的烤鱼腌肉不一样。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/39a377596fd6cf8f291fbd51ddd73c25_3711463268740829914.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"好，出发喝酒去喽！嗯？哈哈哈，平时没人卖酒给你是吧？那不如——","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/7dc768b8916f888aff5f3fc26def91f0_2986620660649934854.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"晚安…","content":"这时间过得可真快。去吧，一帆风顺。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/b7727b03ea00bc385e1bed82b1c28622_6700485058283191702.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于北斗自己…","content":"航海准备，兄弟们，各就各位，全新的冒险要开始了！","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5e00f4dfd8e1415f6b2ef3e8411a3743_7439671385799179882.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·称呼","content":"我是老大，你是我兄弟，没问题吧？哈？这些叫法太老土？行。那就按你喜欢的方式叫吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4a770c6840c3c4bc37caf33f5e868771_8650694003536472870.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·识人","content":"我认人很准。当你见过大海，那么普通人脸上的小水花，可就太好读懂了。哈哈，所以，我第一眼就认准了你这个家伙。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2de628717924a3be61454ee284967579_2616418444876357496.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于我们·选择","content":"你是我选择的船员，是我选择的兄弟。就说这一点，都够我自豪很久。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bebfa7621ae16e3d7c67178050aed10a_1615189243136557794.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"在那些没有「神之眼」的家伙心中，拥有「神之眼」，获得了神的认可的人，应该是旗帜吧。那么，旗帜就该有旗帜的样子。我是这样鞭策自己的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4611126cced2d0fdc67e9908f24fe082_1585577304992246967.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"遇到难题了吗？不知道如何向前的话，总之先迈出第一步，后面的道路就会自然而然地展开了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/9775c8cb6a8adf362d2b6dedb70d83ea_6952586979758396695.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"每次远航回来看见石鸢的时候，就说明差不多快到家了。海上的景色看多了难免单调，相比之下，虽说是猛禽，但那副自在翱翔的模样，总觉得亲切可爱。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3120b69d1f5596a7859eb3c44ecdc9e5_2887448142996986245.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光·璃月七星","content":"凝光啊，从「璃月七星」的角度上来说已经做得很好了吧。只是，我要负责的对象从来就是我的船和兄弟们，不是什么「璃月七星」啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fd6bbb242945754400899ae840714abb_6322694641384121135.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于凝光·态度","content":"凝光一向不怎么坦率，但她曾经很直接地表露过对我的不满。哈哈，不过啊，喜欢和讨厌都是她自己的事情，我是不可能动摇的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/91baf17c800e2f43aa989b3fe30a8a58_7442879246554112177.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱·好厨艺","content":"香菱的一手好菜，可是我们一众人在远航时的念想。没力气的时候，要是想想干煸绝云椒椒那满嘴留香的滋味，都能精神几分。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/5ff21cef7cbc3693693d7a98e5c9a68b_202250071516445381.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于香菱·试吃","content":"香菱啊，她偶尔也会用一些说不上好滋味的食材，做出一些很是了不得的味道。不过嘛，没有尝试就不会有进步，我倒是挺乐意帮她试吃的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c538be9ac8fc9a6e98d1073df4ee2860_7164959372052063553.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于钟离…","content":"你说「往生堂」的那位先生吗？兄弟们有时会聊起他的传言，听上去是个很有意思的人啊。嗯，有机会去结交一下吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3e022e3f5f24e0e07e6b550cae5e4c71_7575500628887217962.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于魈…","content":"有一年海灯节前夕，船队在归航时遭遇了风暴，紧赶慢赶才在入夜时分回到了璃月港。那时候海灯早就散了。我却在孤云阁的方向，看到了空中悬着一个少年模样的仙人。想必就如传闻一样，在人们看不见的地方，也有人在守护这个璃月港吧。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8f312302d19e9ffcc94dbc0a37839347_7919518368573349531.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于甘雨…","content":"我和甘雨那丫头私交不错！但你也知道，她是「璃月七星」的秘书，「七星」不待见我那可不是一天两天了。哈，我倒是无所谓，要连累了那丫头可不行。嗯，对外还是保密得好。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/8280eb49a07cee5af147a5cd38247b65_8129783030666614131.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于辛焱…","content":"哈，很有意思的丫头！船上的兄弟们也有喜欢听她「摇滚」的。嗯…我本人？怎么说呢，虽然在某些方面跟辛焱有共同话题，但我的音乐品味却是另一方面的…","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/4c708d9e441097eb0eeee0fb13cadb70_7415514617246724284.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于瑶瑶…","content":"瑶瑶这个小家伙啊，总是爱到船上来玩。但她那副扑闪着眼睛，见什么都新奇的样子，让谁都狠不下心来赶她走。唉，差点要打乱出航的计划。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/3b1aefa9561a73a0cb8132d314634747_2602021413024510824.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"关于枫原万叶…","content":"听说万叶那小子在天守阁外挡了雷电将军的一刀，不简单嘛！嗯…战争结束后，他回了我们南十字船队，说是继续和我们同行一段时间。我当然是非常欢迎了，如果哪天他决定要独自踏上下一段旅程，我再打一壶好酒为他送行，哈哈。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/fb067f138dd35cd2b93d1c29713f7e6e_6437607761869834090.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其一","content":"想要踏上我的「死兆星」号，得先回答我一个问题。大海之中充满凶险，告诉我——你为什么想上我的船？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/ef73209db6e309a1f6f9107ec1598ab1_2108427904191142429.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其二","content":"那些关于我的传奇故事？哈哈哈，那是兄弟们看重，才在夸我的时候添油加醋。不过，你要问我怕不怕在出海的时候遇到什么魔物，那自然是不怕的。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c14d97d61ce1a03a5f64d5f2b948f037_4752462510059029484.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其三","content":"问我帮助平民的用意？哈，哪有什么用意不用意的。谁的人生还没有个低谷。我的帮助是小事，但对他们而言，迈不迈得过去那道坎，可能就是两条路啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/bd9e685f6305ce8aadf972a7f44da76e_1212368934302718728.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其四","content":"我经历过痛苦的时光。小时候没摩拉买吃的，只好偷人家树上的果子，讨了几年生活。等到有了自己的船队，还是被趾高气昂的商人们排挤在外。但是，这些事当作茶余饭后的笑谈讲给你听，就足够了，我绝不会让你再经历一遍。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/68a23e42682d5dcb24031ee5b0122a74_2292390602091506889.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"想要了解北斗·其五","content":"追随我的兄弟有很多，我问过，我也记得他们每一个人上船的理由。你是很特别的。我知道你还有需要完成的事情，我不会授予你职务和头衔。但无论你的旅途去往何方，「死兆星」号上，永远都有你的位置。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/f0b4667420ffce8beda1b1a3dcc27b8f_7993566492500138716.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"北斗的爱好…","content":"爱好啊…我想想。冒险算一个，掌舵算一个，交朋友算一个，喝酒算一个，吃好吃的算一个…啧，一个手都数不过来啊。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c0bdc378f699efb341b8fcf33d0e8f7a_4089142185370798717.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"北斗的烦恼…","content":"搞得定的事不必烦恼，搞不定的事烦恼也没有意义。我就这样过得快快活活的。哦，要是你遇到什么想不通的事情，你可以来找我。我帮你一起解决。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/77d9d25af8baf55af8519c5ef4e9498c_6234643337301810498.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"我喜欢味道重的菜！什么炝炒肉片啊，麻婆豆腐啊我就很喜欢。能填饱肚子，大家围坐一圈一起吃的时候，气氛也会变得火热火热的。哈，说得我都想去吃一顿了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/199ecc7f3d4ea15013001b5e3b27b40a_3124460569233640917.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"我不太喜欢吃凉菜冷盘。有这慢悠悠开胃的功夫，鱼都能烤熟几条了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/2604b78dc9fe42eabe520983bac1fa83_4211869366282402006.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"好味道，我喜欢！有米饭吗，帮忙添两碗？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/b53ba95466510e710aaacdb8ebd72ba7_191067089888729375.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"你的手艺真不错，让人心情也变得不一样了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/0e1444d8d8f7b4104ba14969ca9fe8d6_2319255745941594752.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"菜是好菜，这就够了。","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/10/31/16576950/4043f90a99095f04b0acadb95da22008_187312596456462570.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"生日…","content":"来，上船。我早就跟兄弟们约好把时间腾出来了，吃的喝的也都准备好了。今天你生日，让你做一天老大。哈！嗯，想去哪？","audio_url":"https://uploadstatic.mihoyo.com/ys-obc/2022/05/12/6276411/c64f2dad0dcf9836385ccdfba48833ea_3504723738894171166.mp3","audio_name":""},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content": 北斗其人，在璃月有着相当的声望。

尽管逊于「璃月七星」，但只要是在城中跑商的人，绝不会不知道北斗与「南十字」的大名。

这样一位人物，自然有着不少传闻。人们说起她，大都是些开山劈海、显神威之能的故事，颇有夸大之嫌。

也有一说：北斗能够举剑引雷，一击将可怖的冥海巨兽劈作两截。

旁人听了，只当是醉汉闲话，并未放在心上。可与北斗同航过的人绝不会将它当成玩笑。他们会说：世上若真有什么冥海巨兽，那北斗一定能将它劈作两截。

由此可见，北斗航海的能力与她在商行的名望一样高。道上称她「龙王」，乃是实至名归。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

商人重利轻情，本不是什么怪事。饭局上说起，也是相视一笑。

唯独璃月人，他们全民皆商，不爱听这话，说起自家城市，总说是「与众不同」。

其余商人听了，笑话他们:不过是将情义二字当成另一种筹码罢了！璃月人便说:「那南十字又要作何解？」

南十字成名多年，佣金昂贵乃是常态。某次航行中，这支船队遭遇了海上飓风，同时遇难的还有附近的一只平民船。北斗见到小船在巨浪中摇曳，顾不得龙骨断裂的危险，下令将平民船拉入安全区。船队内粮水所剩无几，北斗却坚持与平民船共享，更带着他们，在飓风中一路前进。

如此经过数日，南十字总算将平民船送入了就近的泊地。船上商人感怀其救命之恩，因而成为了北斗忠诚的商业伙伴。

璃月人笑道:「丢掉性命也要坚持完成的事，可不是筹码二字能够说清。将情义归为筹码，你敢和北斗说这话吗？」

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

有传闻道:「南十字」背后的势力，乃是「七星」之一的「天权」凝光。

对此，两位当事人矢口否认。不过，她们的理由各自不同。

凝光贵为「七星」，总有需要差人作粗鲁事情的时候。在众多候选人里，她挑中了北斗。

依照凝光的说法，她选中的是北斗这个人，与「南十字」船队的合作才是顺便。

而北斗若是知情，定会恼火地说，她和凝光仅是合作，绝对称不上「背后势力」一说。

凝光的诸多合作者中，唯有北斗与众不同。

她对凝光毫无常人那般敬畏，反倒有些针对，幕僚们因而担忧连连，认为北斗生性桀骜，难以约束。凝光倒不在意，只是笑着说：

「此言差矣。依我看，她才是璃月最好控制的人。只需与她说清大义，道明利害关系，她自会想通。」

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

漫长航行结束，「 南十字」登上陆地，依照惯例举办为期三日的庆功宴。此年秋天与往昔并无二致；唯独市里多了位新出师的小厨娘，正是「万民堂」后来的大厨，香菱。

船队会计贪图便宜，连拐带骗，将市口遇见的厨娘香菱拽上了船。香菱见了北斗，为难万分，苦恼地说:「呃，船上食材都是海味，只能做「月菜」。我可是要超越两大菜系对立的人……」

北斗只是指着脚边一箱金币，笑道:「上一趟差事赚了不少。给你五万摩拉作佣金吧。」

为证明自己料理海味的实力，香菱勉为其难接下了这份工作。

单就结果而言，北斗确实欣赏香菱的手艺。

当着水手们的面，她大胆断言：稍加时日，香菱必会名震璃月港。不仅如此，还让全船海员尊称香菱为「香菱阿姊」。

香菱初出江湖，对北斗这位出手阔绰、为人豪爽的大姐也很是欣赏，常与北斗一同出航，寻找最新奇的海洋食材。她向来特立独行在食材选择方面剑走偏锋。到了海上，香菱却觉得那是北斗的领地。她总是惊讶，北斗一个远离庖厨之人，竟也辨得出各式海产，深谙其饕餮之道。

——当然， 要说香菱会不会听取北斗的选材建议，则是后话了。

{"rich_text":"

俗话说，物似主人形。

虽然不那么恰当，但是「南十字」船队的确和北斗一样，有着一样的气质。

不过船队内还是有些秘密，在北斗看不见的地方流传。

大副会在新水手们第一次归行后， 邀请他们去喝酒，然后绘声绘色地讲述一件旧事：

当年「南十字」踏上对外海的未知探索，曾经多次陷入风暴当中，稍有不慎，船毁人亡。

那时，北斗登上甲板，亲自站在舵轮后，一边操舵，一边在风雨声中唱起璃月渔民的拉网号子。

「直到眼前再无风浪，海天线上霞光一片，天朗波平…」

大副一般都会用满脸怀念的神情，念出这句话作为收尾。

随着船队事业扩大，大副故事中惊世骇俗的描述越来越多，新水手们对北斗的崇拜也越发高涨。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

①面对硕大无朋的三头海蛇，北斗投出了她的大剑，大剑完美地刺穿了海蛇的三根脊椎，旋转着回到了北斗手中。

②北斗在棋局上赢过凝光，两次。重要的不是能赢凝光的钱，而是敢赢凝光的钱。

③北斗当初最后一次唱渔歌是在狩猎海怪「海山」之时。在那以后她就不唱渔歌了。

④是的，没听错。北斗会唱渔歌。你可千万别当面问本人。你想想三头海蛇的下场吧。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

璃月与稻妻中流传着一句短语: 「鳍化冥海，尾点远山」。渔人从岸上学来这句翻来覆去地唱。曲子越传越远，成为脍炙人口的渔歌。每到海上起雾，渔民们的小船隐没在白雾里，歌声遥遥传来:鳍化冥海，尾点远山…

这首歌便是北斗的摇篮曲。岩王帝君神剑斩海怪，璃月人将之传为美谈。年幼的北斗爱听神话，睡觉也想着:总有一天得见见这条大鱼。

今天，她却用另一种心情唱起这首歌。全船海员跟着哼唱，扬帆起航。

海山就在海中。它既像鱼也像龙，庞大如噩梦，力大如神灵，轻轻一击便能掀起数十米高的巨浪。

在海上搏命的人，总会与海山相遇。北斗从九岁就想见它，盼着能将它的头颅一刀斩下。

她曾多次挑战海山，均以失败告终。今天却不同，北斗背上最好的大剑，带上最通水性的水手，直奔海山而去。

短兵相接，一战惊雷。这场战斗持续了整整四天。船队携带大炮、渔枪，辅以弓箭和绳索，全力牵制海山。北斗与四足被缚的海山缠斗数个时辰，直至天黑也没能分出胜负。

夜晚是海山最危险的时刻。人们提防着海山的进犯，整夜不敢入睡。北斗站在船头，聆听风声。

一击，只要一击。她在寒风中一动不动地等待。

不知过去多久，粒米未进、滴水未沾的北斗精准捕捉到太阳升起刹那，海中传来的浪花声。

这一击，破云斩月，如山如海，将鱼龙的头颅彻底砍断！

伴随漫天惊雷，一道紫电自半空降下，凝聚在浴血的北斗面前。

屠龙者北斗的「神之眼」自天上而来，有着雷电般夺目的紫光，是龙血也无法匹敌的宝珠。这颗神玉，只应赠给山与海的征服者。

主题：难得有空…

发件人：北斗

时间：2026-02-14

呦，好久不见，最近还好吗？我刚在挪德卡莱谈了一桩大买卖，现在正带着船队在璃月港备货呢。挪德卡莱那么远，可得好好赚一笔才行。

该说不说，比起陆地上的生活，我还是更享受在大海里的日子。面对一堆复杂文书还能不犯困，这种毅力恐怕只有咱们的天权星大人能做到吧！

好了不说这些了，难得有空，朋友们都聚齐了，咱也别浪费机会,来一起聊聊最近的冒险吧!不然又得各忙各的了。

对了，这些冬凌草是我前阵子谈买卖时顺手采来的，觉得挺不错，就带回来送你。希望你会喜欢！

我等你，不见不散!

主题：休整间隙…

发件人：北斗

时间：2025-02-14

船队这会正在奥摩斯港休整呢，刚才随意走进了一家酒馆，没想到老板是个不折不扣的航海迷，还大方地送了几道拿手菜！哈，璃月讲究礼尚往来，我能白拿人家好处吗？大副已经请老板上甲板参观去了，祝他玩得开心！

每逢遇到投契的新朋友，就免不了想起你来！近来怎么样？趁着好酒好菜在前，要不要来见一面？

时间得抓紧咯，吃饱喝足后马上就要再次启航了。不可否认，港口的确很宁静舒适，但死兆星号可是为了波涛而生的。

你也同意的吧？哈哈！

主题：异国见闻…

发件人：北斗

时间：2024-02-14

前阵子，我带领船队拓展航线，途径遗珑埠，接着一路往西开到了枫丹的柔灯港。

航海这么多年，什么大风大浪没见过？但这次我在当地人的推荐下尝试了潜水，没想到又见识到了一个新奇的世界。

采海露花的时候，几只重甲蟹张牙舞爪地把我围了起来，我干脆一拳一个把它们都放倒了。你别说，久违地徒手战斗一回，感觉还挺畅快。

还有这些幽光星星，看着挺漂亮。随信一起寄给你。当作纪念品。有机会就来找我聚聚，我给你准备几道小菜，一起聊聊近来的冒险吧。

主题：鱼宴…

发件人：北斗

时间：2023-02-14

今早我动手捕了条鱼，差不多有一艘小船那么大吧。正巧赶上我生日，我干脆就请万民堂用它办了个全鱼宴。

说起这条鱼，第一次逮它的时候这家伙本来已经被钩住了嘴，但没想到它那尾巴力气不小，一连扇红了好几个水手的脸，最后硬是挣脱了铁钩，游回了海里。

要是连一条鱼都制不住，我的船队也不配叫「南十字」了。总而言之，它现在已经老老实实被做成了水煮鱼。比起寻常的海鱼，这鱼的肉劲道了许多，味道也是一绝，你一定要来尝尝啊。

主题：好东西！

发件人：北斗

时间：2022-02-14

最近弄了点品相不错的夜泊石，刚好等会儿给你带去。我对矿石研究不深，但好东西还是不会看走眼的，

这些石头放在我手里，无非就那么些常规用途，给你倒是说不定会有新思路。想收藏用，还是想做首饰、做武器？哈哈，根据这个结果，也能看出你对矿石的品味，让我也见识一下你的水平。

今天我很闲，你呢？有时间吗，要不要跟我随处转转？

什么都不用带。吃喝我包。也算是我们俩的老规矩了。

你心里有数的吧？不见不散！

主题：最近过得可好？

发件人：北斗

时间：2021-02-14

时间过得可真快。这有时候一上船就不知道什么时候脚才能着地，好巧不巧，这次出航遇上了暴风雨，电闪雷鸣，有两个水手还以为回不来了。

哈，那我岂能让他们害怕。这不连人带船开回家了。

来见我一面吧！今儿是个好日子，让你尝尝我的手艺。

对了，路上我顺道摘了些新鲜的「琉璃袋」，给你寄去了。听香菱说你有阵子一直在找这种香料。下次有这种需要，直接跟我说一声得了。我帮你准备。
